question: The body of the phylum ________ is unsegmented and dorsoventrally flattened.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Platyhelminthes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phylum **Platyhelminthes** consists of organisms that have an unsegmented, dorsoventrally flattened body.
 
• These organisms are commonly known as flatworms.
 
• Flatworms exhibit bilateral symmetry and a lack of body cavity (acoelomate).
 
• Members of this phylum include planarians, flukes, and tapeworms.
 
• Platyhelminthes have a simple digestive system with a single opening serving as both mouth and anus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coelenterata** (also known as Cnidaria) includes organisms like jellyfish and corals that have a radially symmetrical body and a gastrovascular cavity.
 
• **Mollusca** consists of soft-bodied animals like snails, clams, and squids, usually with a hard shell made of calcium carbonate.
 
• **Arthropoda** is the largest phylum in the animal kingdom and includes insects, arachnids, myriapods, and crustaceans, characterized by a segmented body and jointed appendages.
 
• The correct answer is option **4) Platyhelminthes**.
